reading.text:
A Visit to the Community Garden

Last Saturday morning, Maya followed her grandmother to the community garden near their block. The garden was small, but it was full of life. Rows of vegetables grew neatly beside pots of colourful flowers. A group of residents were watering the plants, pulling out weeds, and chatting cheerfully.

Maya noticed an elderly man struggling to carry a heavy watering can. Without waiting to be asked, she walked over and offered to help him. The man smiled gratefully and showed her how to water the plants gently without flooding the soil.

By the end of the morning, Maya felt tired but happy. She realised that a community garden was not just a place for growing plants. It was also a place where neighbours could work together, make friends, and care for one another.

reading.text:
A Visit to the Community Garden

Last Saturday morning, Maya followed her grandmother to the community garden near their block. The garden was small, but it was full of life. Rows of vegetables grew neatly beside pots of colourful flowers. A group of residents were watering the plants, pulling out weeds, and chatting cheerfully.

Maya noticed an elderly man struggling to carry a heavy watering can. Without waiting to be asked, she walked over and offered to help him. The man smiled gratefully and showed her how to water the plants gently without flooding the soil.

By the end of the morning, Maya felt tired but happy. She realised that a community garden was not just a place for growing plants. It was also a place where neighbours could work together, make friends, and care for one another.

reading.text:
A Visit to the Community Garden

Last Saturday morning, Maya followed her grandmother to the community garden near their block. The garden was small, but it was full of life. Rows of vegetables grew neatly beside pots of colourful flowers. A group of residents were watering the plants, pulling out weeds, and chatting cheerfully.

Maya noticed an elderly man struggling to carry a heavy watering can. Without waiting to be asked, she walked over and offered to help him. The man smiled gratefully and showed her how to water the plants gently without flooding the soil.

By the end of the morning, Maya felt tired but happy. She realised that a community garden was not just a place for growing plants. It was also a place where neighbours could work together, make friends, and care for one another.
